📜 More About Shujinkou
Shujinkou marks Rice Games' debut commercial title and the first installment in a planned trilogy. The game's expansive world spans six nations, each with its own story arc and a rich cast of major and minor characters.

This year's release includes both the Genya Arc and the Sabaku Arc. The Genya Arc follows the battle against the language-devouring "Akuma" to save Shu’s homeland, while the Sabaku Arc explores diplomacy in a new nation and the struggle to alter an ally's prophesied fate, revealed through a mysterious painting.

Each arc offers roughly 40–60 hours of gameplay and introduces its own cast of new protagonists to befriend and antagonists to face.


💯 Thousands of Players Learning AND Gaming! 
Since launch, thousands of players around the world have enjoyed Shujinkou, with many fans sharing directly with us that the game inspired them to start pursuing Japanese language classes and even helped some land new jobs connected to their passion for Japanese.

Others have spent hundreds of hours exploring Shujinkou's 200 quests, multiple minigames, and thousands of character interactions across its expansive cast. Based on player data, earning the Platinum trophy typically takes roughly 250 hours, reflecting Shujinkou's breadth of unique content.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/55fdce05ecbdd4ac41b10c96c2924dee6f0508d8.jpg"]
⚙️ Reviews and Feedback
Preliminary reviews have been excellent, with Shujinkou earning a 90 Metacritic score (Universal Acclaim) and a 94 OpenCritic Top Critic score as of August 2025. 



We've submitted over 70 review keys worldwide, but as a small self-publishing studio, it remains a challenge to gain broad media attention. Sales have been modest on PC but have exceeded expectations on PlayStation, and we remain committed to supporting the game with monthly patches across all platforms.


🎮 Looking forward with the Nintendo Switch port
With its upcoming Nintendo Switch release, players can explore dozens of handcrafted labyrinths on the go and even use the touchscreen to practice writing hiragana, katakana, and a wide range of kanji.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/b2f4dfdfdc36de163097c06955706abf691d6d0b.jpg"]


🍚 About the Rice Games Team
Rice Games Inc is a multilingual team of game developers from around the world. Many team members are fluent or native speakers of multiple languages, including English, Japanese, German, and Mandarin.

With teammates spread across more than seven time zones, ensuring smooth coordination over Shujinkou's over six-year development period was no small feat. The team's global presence spans several countries, including:

United States: California, Hawaii, Washington, Texas, Florida, Minnesota, Michigan, Colorado, Utah, etc.

Japan, Australia, United Kingdom, Germany

The Rice Games team is composed largely of young, highly motivated individuals eager to leave their mark on the video game industry with their first major commercial release. While some team members bring years of experience—particularly within the Music Team, with arrangement and composition credits—they, too, are venturing into new territory, having never worked on an RPG of Shujinkou's scale.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/920e106efe46196f15a2885801f5d374a5499faa.jpg"]


Thanks for reading this major update, and we hope to see you dungeon-crawling on the Nintendo Switch next month :).

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.41
notes.content:
Shujinkou v1.41Polish / Quality of Life
🌟 There are now two new options to disable the Logo animation and Mother's Dedication scene, which can reduce game initial startup time by up to 20 seconds.

🌟 Lore Compilation Menu: Check out some of the trivia that you have encountered in loading screens in the Lexicon section of the Party Menu! As this is a new feature, data will begin tracking for the first time as you continue your journey in Shujinkou.

🌟 Added Fish Legend UI, which indicates which fish can be most or least effectively caught based on selected bait. This is found in the Bait Select menu when fishing. Fish that have not been encountered before are marked with a question mark.

The area and optimal time to find an akuma is displayed even if it has yet to be discovered in the Bestiary.

Additional dialogue options added to the youkyuu: Choice of Care.


Bug Fixes
Fix bug with fishing odds becoming less random as the player fishes more and more frequently.

Fix bug with being unable to click party selection UI with mouse or touchpad in Battle, Skill Use, and Item Menu screens.

Fix UI issues with Bunpou Kake when input spamming.

Fix issue with a treasure chest that unlocks too early in Town 1.

Fix right-shoulder button icon shown for Kanakae tutorial when it should be the left-shoulder button icon.

Fix bug with AP (Arawasu Points) rewards when leveling up more than once at one time.

PC: Fixed link URL when clicking the OST button in the Jukebox Menu.

Fix harmless exception that would appear in Bunpou Kake when pressing shoulder buttons.

Fix harmless exception when pressing certain face buttons after completing a round of Sakana Sensou.

Fix harmless exception thrown when pressing certain buttons after some time passes after the player has checked the Kanban Menu.

Fixed input soft lock that could happen at the Omikuji and improve button visuals.

Fixed cursor selection sometimes disappearing when pressing left on the OK button in the Party Swap menu.

Fix UI sound effect growing louder and louder over time as the player interacts more and more with the Skill Use menu in the Party Menu.

Dialogue speech bubbles are now hidden for outdoor shop owners.

Typos, small lore and timing consistency issues, and other small bugs fixed.

Prevent Nation indicators in towns from being affected by ambient lighting.


Our Biggest Priorities
We want to add a "Fast-Forward" (by holding a certain key) to some minigames so that they can be played and progressed through more quickly. 

We've noticed some physics inconsistencies in Tatiana's minigame, Kotoba Kyuugi, and are looking to fix this in the near future.

We've noticed that when holding a button to move, then sliding your hand (while still holding the button) to another button occasionally does not allow the player to rotate properly in the dungeon. We are looking to fix in the near future.

There are some users still experiencing issues with widescreen play, for example with selectable resolutions not appearing in the dropdown option. We are going to revisit this next month.


Thank you!
Thank you Shujinkou players for your continued support and QOL requests! Feel free to join our Discord community if you need assistance with gameplay, want to suggest features or provide constructive feedback, or want to meet and chat with other fans of Shujinkou!

https://discord.com/invite/UdCdvSuwpk

notes.title: Shujinkou Scores 9.5/10 at Digital Chumps!
notes.content:
New Review is Live!
Our seventh Metacritic-affiliated review is here (sixth on PS5)! We got a review from Digital Chumps's Editor-in-Chief Nathaniel Stevens, scoring Shujinkou at an "Amazing" 9.5/10.


Please give the full review a read here:
https://digitalchumps.com/shujinkou-review-ps5/

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/f6fcf7dfe16024f4d409ae9f072ff20a8d2bd8de.jpg"]
Excerpts from the Review
"Shujinkou from developer Rice Games Inc. is a fascinating journey. It has everything you would want with a JPRG delivered with classic 16-bit flavor. This package includes cool enemies, tough maze levels to travel through, and an easy-to-pick-up backbone that is far deeper than I anticipated. On top of it all, it delivers a fun way to learn the Japanese language."


"I haven’t had this much fun learning since playing Oregon Trail back in 1983 on a Texas Instruments computer. Sometimes learning through games can be a blast. Even if the learning portion of the game happens to be about the Japanese language. What a unique experience."


"This type of story and form harkens back to the days of Phantasy Star, where the gameplay was a slow burn but complemented by a great story and interesting dungeon-crawling experience. It was a blend that melded together perfectly to deliver what I still consider one of the best JRPG experiences of my lifetime. Shujinkou goes along those same lines."


"I cannot imagine the amount of time it took to integrate these signs into the game and try to find a pattern or path to take the player down, so it doesn’t feel like jumbled material mixed with a good JRPG construct. For every sign I ran into, I was impressed enough with its delivery and design to sit back and learn what was trying to be taught."


"This added element of Japanese language learning gameplay pushes this game into uncharted fun that most JRPGs wish they achieved. Getting a solid JRPG mixed with a gamification experience means that you’re learning as you’re being entertained. That’s a great combo."


Review Conclusion
"Shujinkou from developer Rice Games is a surprisingly entertaining JRPG that features a design that harkens back to early elements of the genre, while mixing in a learning experience to further its beautiful complication."



This now brings Shujinkou's Metacritic score back up from 89 to 90, and our OpenCritic score from 93.75 to 94.

Visuals: The six partners, Shu, Jin, Kou, Kyuukou, and Tsurugi look better than ever with improved texture optimizations—they now look even better on large TV screens!

Fixed an issue where the Cover Illustration for the Akagi would not appear when entering the area from the Nation Map.

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.39
notes.content:
Shujinkou v1.39Polish / Quality of Life
Big news! You can now press Square on PS5/PS4 or Z on PC while in towns to open the new Quick Travel menu, which allows you to very quickly jump to important shops and the town's exit. This feature becomes accessible once you are able to enter Labyrinth 1.

Players can now sprint and rotate more quickly in the labyrinth.

The time of day will no longer stop a player's active movement unless Jin's Nen'oshi is set to trigger (during Day).

There is a new, brief initial-startup screen before the logo animation plays.

The Chizu (map) now shows a checkmark icon for Kanban (signboards) that have been viewed in a labyrinth.

Requested by a player here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1386630/discussions/0/591767767138460998/

The newest and strongest equipment now appear first when scrolling through the Buy menu for Weapons and Armor in Daisuke's Mokubukiya.


Bug Fixes
D-pad controller movement no longer lags and now works smoothly in all labyrinths. Our apologies for the inconvenience this may have brought and how long it took to fix this up.

Fix text-flickering that would occasionally appear in battles.

A rare case of movement soft-locks/freezing in labyrinths when mashing various inputs has been fixed.

Fix the bugged timer counting down too quickly for Battle Escape and Kakusei when Very Fast Battle Speed is set in the options.

Fix visual issue with some characters not being properly animated in Himamura during the early game.

Fix Kanban sometimes loading the second page first when consecutively viewing it two or more times.

Fix bug with Labyrinth 2's Junshu Yajuu sometimes triggering a battle during its rest turn (it should not).

Fix awkward illustration positioning for Toushirou when he reaches level 20 and 30 (edge-case).

Fixed a degradation with Labyrinth 5's sky illustrations. Our apologies!

notes.title: Patch - Steam Cloud Fix
notes.content:
Shujinkou Hot Patch - Steam Cloud Fix
This small update (linked build # included) fixes the Steam Cloud saving / loading issue that was reported by a lot of players. This new patch confirms working Steam Cloud and also includes the new menu called Steam Cloud Save Conflict Menu:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/73a4d7b392b0ad2a5880f32de756da1d4155a7de.jpg

In this menu, you will have the option to play with locally stored save data or the last saved Steam Cloud save data.

As mentioned in the help text in the screenshot, please be warned that choosing one save data, then saving the game after that, will cause the other save data to be overwritten and permanently deleted. This also occurs when opening and closing the Option Menu in both the Main Menu and in the Party Menu.

Here is a zoomed-in image for those curious about the flow.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/e6078fe325902281f6077e05a432e35700ba311d.jpg

In the unfortunate event that you unintentionally overwrite the wrong save, please send an email with your Steam username to contact@ricegames.net with the subject title Recover Lost Save Data and we will see if there's anything that can be done to recover it.

If this doesn't appear for you when you start the game, please save the game (with Steam Cloud synced/enabled) once on the device with your preferred / primary save data, then start the game on your secondary device.

Also, please note that if you pick the Steam Cloud save but do not save when quitting the game, this menu will appear when you return to the Main Menu.

Happy dungeon-crawling! We're finally starting to see some players on PS5 and PC reach the second half of the campaign and approach the conclusion of the story. Our most dedicated players have averaged over 10 hours a day with 150+ hours put into both the game's main and side content! 🤩

 Skills that replenish TR, MR, or both after a hero's turn or after the end of battle do not trigger if the hero is fully healed for the target stat(s). This slightly improves the flow of battle.
 When winning a battle, any skills that heal the heroes after the battle will now properly update the bars of health seen for the hero UI when the battle message appears. This was a minor oversight.

Balancing

 Bonus Skills like To Recuperate, To Restore, To Revitalize, To Regenerate, and To Replenish would not stack, and high-value skills would be overridden by lower-value skills. Now, these skills stack, allowing for more fair usage of AP and strategy.

Miscellaneous

Our Biggest Feature / Fix Priorities

 PS5 Save Data Transfer from Demo to Full Game (optional for those who want to use it).

 We are working on a fix for playing on ultrawide monitors.

 Loading Lore Menu in the Party Menu (Lexicon) is in development.

Crashes are never intentional, and we do our best to catch everything we can.

Whenever a crash or exception happens, the team gets a notification about it, and I add it to the urgent list of things to fix for the next patch. We'll keep our eyes peeled for any more issues and hope you continue to have a fun time playing through Shujinkou!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.32
notes.content:
Shujinkou v1.32
Polish / Quality of Life

 PC-Only - Right Click to Go Back: Now, you can right-click to go back on all menus, including every menu in the Party Menu, Shop menus, Battle menus, and more.
 Rank Requirements for each minigame now displayed in the Records menu when signing up for a minigame. This transparency will allow players to make better decisions as to what rank to gamble for.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/e824a19e337016f2e5a6ce4892f8fd581780e60f.png
Now, you will be able to cycle through four displays and override your current settings at any time, similar to the English-Only mode. This was a highly requested feature by our language learners.

 Optimized PS4 version to reduce likelihood of memory crashes.
 Fixed one mistyped choice option in Tatiana's second Kizuna quest.
 Fixed spoilers appearing in Ishi 9 for Otogawa and Sugi.
 Fixed wrong character named for unlocked costume when completing a series of Kizuna quests.
 Fix rare crash during specific conditions when in the Fuu Underground.

Balancing

 Raised Inventory maximum for Ingredients from 60 to 99.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/70d2c395633d30c557b39dc8003066f752678de0.png
If you have Hold to Mash enabled, certain mashing activities will show a new UI component to remind you of the setting. Because input processing currently differs between holding to mash and not holding at all, this should reduce confusion for players having trouble mashing when Hold to Mash is enabled.

Miscellaneous

 Adjust grammar and word Kanban so that the sentences on the top take the whole width.
 Youkyuu tutorial updated to say a max of "twelve" quests instead of "five."


Our Biggest Feature / Fix Priorities

 PS5 Save Data Transfer from Demo to Full Game (optional for those who want to use it).
 There seems to be an issue with Steam Cloud for many users.
 We are still working on further optimizing the PS4 version.
 We are still working on fixing the displays for ultrawide monitors.
 Investigating the Tsuri (Fishing) minigame input issue on some PCs.
 Loading Lore Menu in the Party Menu (Lexicon) is in development.
 D-pad movement, especially with controller, as well as keyboard-only movement, can be slow and laggy, and not fun for dungeon-crawlers who are more accustomed to D-pad movement (instead of the L-stick, which currently is the smoothest working solution).
 We want to add a "Fast-Forward" (by holding a certain key) to some minigames so that they can be played and progressed through more quickly.

 BUG: At least one player ran into an issue when starting a random encounter. It seems very rare and isolated, and we're looking into the issue.
 BUG: Lighting issues (areas are too bright) for a small subset of computers, specifically in labyrinths during Dusk and Night (sometimes Dawn), but also sometimes on the Nation Map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38470489/6662fe0becec4019864b78816a86b349c59410e7.jpg
Lengthy sentences like the one seen in the Kanban above now take up the entire width of the Kanban page, allowing for greatly reduced likelihood of text overflow into the second line.

As always, thank you for playing! Our team will be getting into marketing mode once a couple more important issues have been ironed out. Expect announcements for cool things in the coming weeks!
Julian Rice

 Experience an 80-hour story—the campaign is primarily split into two major arcs.

 Bond with six passionate partners and experience 42 story quests & 120 short events.
 View over 80 special 4K illustrations throughout the main story and partner content.
 Play six minigames that review various aspects of Japanese—there's fishing too!
 Enjoy a seven-hour, 158 track soundtrack featuring over a dozen musical genres.

While this is only one review from one publication, it was reviewed by someone who played through Shujinkou's entire story campaign, something that reviewers at other publications are aiming to progress through right now! notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (v1.05)
notes.content:
Heya! We've got a new patch released for the demo. A couple more important bugs have been addressed and squashed, and a few QOL additions have made their way into the Demo.

Patch Notes 1.05 (November 25th, 2024)
QOL / Balancing

 New Feature: Sprint by Default - False by default, but you can now go to the Options Menu to change movement so that players can SPRINT by default rather than walk.
 Select "End tutorial button" on Back press - If you are using a controller and end up deselecting the button for ending a tutorial, you can now press "Back" (Circle button, B on Xbox) to go back.
 Controller's R Stick now moves more smoothly when selecting kanakae orbs in battle. It used to default to a set position on the screen, but now the cursor can move in a circular direction. Some added buffers also prevent the cursor from auto-selecting an orb without the player's intention.
 Size of the Uma enemy (Horse) has been increased.
 Minor balancing for some bosses in Genya and enemies in Sanrin.
 Adjust Tsuri (Fishing) algorithm so that the grade of the Bait that you select has a greater impact on how easy (or difficult) it is to fish up any kind of fish.
 Remove the unnecessary and slightly too-wordy "Storage" tutorial.
 Polish all textual data for example words used in all Hiragana and Katakana Kanban so that the font doesn't become too small and so that it's legible even on smaller screens (like the Steam Deck).


Bug Fixes

 Forge sometimes doesn't work when first pressing the "Forge" button. Fixed!
 Fix Battle Speed setting sometimes lasting beyond the end of battle.
 Prevent menu scroll null exception error that would rarely take place if a player spammed inputs when leaving the game and returning to the main menu.
 Fix issue with Tsuri (Fishing) minigame's input not working properly on certain devices if a controller is connected and the D-pad is used as an input, and when Hold to Mash is turned off.
 Fix issue with Jin's Nen'oshi being rounded up to a whole number only for display, when the value should be rounded down.
 Fix a formula issue with Ontological Weaknesses not increasing the damage multiplier as much as it really should (now you'll deal EVEN MORE damage!)


Thank you for taking the time to read our patch notes!
Julian

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (v1.04)
notes.content:
Hello! We've got a new patch released for the demo. A couple important bugs have been addressed and squashed, and a few QOL additions have made their way into the Demo.

Patch Notes 1.04 (November 18th, 2024)
QOL

 Hero status change preview preserves its state in Mokubukiya now, so you can scroll through items and it'll show the preview with how their attributes would change when comparing their currently equipped weapon or armor with the currently selected weapon or armor.
 Labyrinth control indicators (Strafe, Dash, Chizu) appear if the player idles for 5 seconds.

Bug Fixes

 Four enemies had incorrect positioning for their Move Order icon and Enemy View menu fixed.
 Rarely, a Hitokoto can cause an exception in loading screen. Hitokoto are the spoken barks on the bottom left of the screen, often seen when in the labyrinths and nation map.
 Dialogue not being clickable with mouse after a Hunt quest's Hunt requirement has been cleared and Hunt kaiwa exists for said specific quest.
 Camera jumps abruptly when an akuma is defeated—this was not the intended behavior and has been fixed for a MUCH smoother experience.
 At least half of the issues with UI clipping mysterious black textures covering various UI elements have been resolved. There are still a few more instances to investigate and fix.
 Update Momoko's Sadou illustration's thumbnail in the Gallery Menu to reflect the adjusted wooden ladle position.
 Fixed rare game-breaking bug where you couldn't get back into the game if you save while having the "Heal TR Gradually" Arawasu skill active.
 Volume for the track "Happy Days" was a bit too quiet so it's been amped up.
 Kanakae Orb duplication bug reported here has been fixed.
 Fix very rare crash in the loading screen that could happen when leaving Himamura and heading to the Nation.


Thanks again for taking the time to read our patch notes!
Julian

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes (v1.03)
notes.content:
Hello! We've got a new patch released for the demo. Because we didn't post an announcement for the initial two patches, which took place on Day 1 and 2 respectively when the demo was released, the notes for those patches will be included here too.

Patch Notes 1.03 (November 13th, 2024)

Add "Reminder to Save" toggle option in Options Menu.

 If enabled, the game will remind you after a few consecutive random encounters (if you have not saved) to save. If you say yes, the game will save immediately—this streamlines gameplay and grinding a bit and reduces the need to have to always go to the Party Menu to save.
 If disabled, the game will not remind you to save.
 When this appears in-game, you have the option to Snooze. Snoozing will automatically turn the toggle option OFF/disabled. You can adjust these settings again in the Options menu.
 IMPORTANT: This setting is set to OFF/disabled if you already have existing save data.

Add "Visible in Background" toggle option in Options Menu.

 If enabled, the game remains active when changing tabs/screens/monitors/apps.
 If disabled, the game's app/music stops and/or disappears when changing tabs/screens/monitors/apps.

Implement up/down paging for the Kemono Kiroku (Bestiary)

 Usually you can skip through (10 entries at a time) by pressing Left/Right, but now you can also press Down when on the last active button, and press Up when on the first active button, and that will automatically take you to the next page of enemies/akuma to view.

Miscellaneous

 Pause main menu music during the Dedication screen and wait until the player clicks to continue before resuming the music
 Fix exception when spamming inputs right after leaving the game to return to the main menu.
 Fix exception when saving and loading the game after using an Arawasu skill that acts similarly to a Field item.
 Fix exception when quickly mashing inputs in Mokubukiya and other shops to buy or sell items.
 Fix input soft-lock when quickly mashing enter/exit inputs in Omikuji
 Improve wooden ladle position in the first special Sadou illustration with Momoko.

Patch Notes 1.02 (November 4th, 2024)

 Implement "M Key" as another way to open/close the Chizu in labyrinths.
 Auto-detect if the current in-game resolution setting is too low, and auto-adjust from there.
 Fix exception when clicking Discord Community UI shortly after "Continue" is pressed.
 Fix exception relating to Mokubukiya when out in the labyrinth.
 Fix exception when spamming buttons/inputs right before a conversation is about to start.
 Fix exception when spamming buttons/inputs in any Healing Station.
 Fix some Himamura minor characters appearing visually funky in the town.
 Update some art assets with polished versions, specifically 5 normal Akuma / enemies.

Patch Notes 1.01 (November 3rd, 2024)

 Add "click to continue" feature to Dedication screen at the start of the game.
 Fix edge case with certain text not being initialized properly in the loading screen.


Thanks for taking the time to read our patch notes!
Julian
